data.name: Rakoczi
data.detailed_description:
Rákóczi Swordfighting Game


Become a soldier of Ferenc Rákóczi and fight for freedom!

The Rákóczi swordfighting game is an exciting, action-packed game that takes players back to the time of Ferenc Rákóczi's freedom fight. Players can take on the role of a soldier and participate in battles, helping the freedom fight with their own skill and courage.

In the game, players can fight each other with different swords, sabers, and other weapons. Players can also learn different techniques that they can use in battles.

In the game, players can participate in different battles that are taken from history. Players can participate in battles between the kuruc and the labanc, as well as other important events of the freedom fight.

The Rákóczi swordfighting game is a great way to experience the excitement of the Rákóczi freedom fight. The game is exciting and challenging, and it provides excellent entertainment for the whole family.

Key Features

  • exciting and Action-packed Gameplay

    • [/h2]

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of historical warfare, including sword combat, firearms, battle scenes, and non-graphic violence. Players may engage in combat against human enemies during quests and military encounters.

The game does not contain sexual content, nudity, rape, non-consensual sexual acts, self-harm, or drug use. Alcohol may be referenced in a historical context but is not a gameplay focus.

All violence is presented in a non-graphic manner and is consistent with a historical action-adventure experience set during the Rákóczi War of Independence.
